name: Ginebra San Miguel
distillery: Ginebra San Miguel, Inc. (six distilleries: Cebu, Pangasinan, Laguna, Isabela, Albay, and Kanchanaburi, Thailand)
owner: Ginebra San Miguel, Inc. (San Miguel Corporation)
production: Described as a Dutch-type gin (genever style)
history: 1834 | Brand founded, first produced at Ayala Distillery, Quiapo, Manila
1917 | 'Marca Demonio' label created by artist Fernando Amorsolo
1987 | Company becomes La Tondeña Distillers, Inc.
2003 | Company renamed Ginebra San Miguel, Inc.
notes: Source is a review site, not the brand. Brand discloses only juniper and 'a mix of other ingredients'; other botanicals per reviewer. Square bottle known as 'cuatro cantos'. Reviewer suggests Negroni or G&T with lemon, not neat.
